name: Weather Icons
about: Weather Icons is a free, open-source icon set with 601 icons designed by Erik Flowers. Covers sun, clouds, rain, snow, storms, fog, wind and more - made for weather apps and dashboards. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under Open Font License.

faqs.q: Are Weather Icons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 601 Weather Icons are open source under the Open Font License license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the Open Font License terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: What weather conditions do Weather Icons cover?
faqs.a: Sun, clouds, rain, snow, storms, fog, wind and more. Search the set for the condition you need – each icon is a clean vector you can recolor to match your app.

faqs.q: How do I use Weather Icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Weather Icons are there?
faqs.a: There are 601 icons in the Weather Icons set, designed by Erik Flowers. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: What formats are Weather Icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
